subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: Should maintainers make this PR the canonical fix for the Telegram over-limit `/model` callback issue, or choose the open sibling implementation instead?
rationale: Both open candidates address the same user-visible bug with different callback contracts, and this callback resolves provider/model routing into session overrides.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Land this minimal index-plus-identity fallback if maintainers prefer preserving existing name-based callbacks for every model that already fits.

options.title: Use the sibling candidate
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 instead if maintainers prefer its broader indexed callback contract, then pause or close this PR.

options.title: Hold for owner selection
options.body: Keep both candidates open until a Telegram owner explicitly selects the callback format, accepting the extra review round trip.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Land this minimal index-plus-identity fallback if maintainers prefer preserving existing name-based callbacks for every model that already fits.

likelyOwner.reason: The byte-limit refactor and current-line blame make this the best available routing owner for the callback-format choice.
